- [ ] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

# What does this PR do?

Fixes static-batching Mamba decode with more than one request. Before this fix, the whole batch was decoded as one request's token sequence.

**Bug.** `MambaMixer._static_decode` projects the sequence-first decode input `(1, b, d_model)` to `zxBCdt` of shape `(1, b, proj)`. It passed that tensor unchanged to `ssm_decode`, which takes batch-first `(batch, seq, proj)` input. When `b > 1`, the decode kernels saw one request with a `b`-token (speculative-style) sequence:
- `causal_conv1d_update` and `selective_state_update` ran all `b` tokens through state slot 0, one after another.
- Slots `1..b-1` were never updated.
- Every request except the first got a wrong output.

The output still had the `(1, b, d_inner)` shape that `out_proj` expects, so nothing failed loudly.

This affects legacy static-batching inference (`StaticInferenceContext`: the static engine and `generate_all_output_tokens_static_batch`) for any model with Mamba layers, on every decode step, whenever the micro-batch is larger than 1. Dynamic batching is not affected. Neither is `GatedDeltaProduct`, whose static decode already transposes. The bug came in with #3594 (8f539df74), which made `ssm_decode` batch-first and moved the transpose into the dynamic path only. It went unnoticed because the static functional recipes use micro-batch 1, and `test_hybrid_model.py::test_inference` runs batch 2 but checks only shapes. On H100, a batch-2 step compared with two batch-1 steps gave: request 1 output max error 1.33, conv/SSM states of both slots wrong (up to 5.8), and slot 1 never updated.

**Fix.**
- **Layout.** Transpose the projection to `(b, 1, proj)` before `ssm_decode`, and transpose the result back to `(1, b, d_inner)` for `out_proj`, the same way `GatedDeltaProduct._static_decode` does. Both transposes are views that PyTorch treats as contiguous, because they only move a size-1 dimension. So the change adds no copies, allocations, syncs or launches. At `b = 1` the computation is unchanged.
- **Shape check.** `ssm_decode` now asserts, when it gets no `batch_indices`, that the batch dimension equals the number of conv/SSM state slots. In that case request `i` uses slot `i`, so the counts must match. This makes the bug class fail loudly: a sequence-first input now raises instead of returning a correctly shaped wrong result. The check compares host-side shapes only, so it adds no sync and is CUDA-graph safe. Dynamic batching always passes `batch_indices`, so it never runs this check.

**Tests.**
- `tests/unit_tests/ssm/test_mamba_mixer.py::TestMambaMixer::test_static_decode_is_per_request[1|2]` runs one static decode step through `MambaMixer.forward`, starting from distinct per-request conv/SSM states in the static cache. It checks the output and every state slot against a reference: the same in/out projections around one single-request `ssm_decode` per state slot. Production and reference run the same GEMM shapes, so the fp32 comparison is tight (`1e-5`). `[2]` fails on `main` and passes with this PR.
- `TestMambaMixer::test_ssm_decode_is_batch_separable` checks that batch-first `ssm_decode` (the layout dynamic batching uses) equals one call per request.
- `TestMambaMixer::test_ssm_decode_rejects_sequence_first_input` checks that the new shape check rejects a `(1, b, proj)` input when there are `b` state slots.
- `tests/unit_tests/models/test_hybrid_model.py::TestHybridModel::test_static_batch_inference_matches_single_requests` runs a `HybridModel` (Mamba, attention and MLP layers) end to end:
  - a batch-2 static prefill, then two decode steps;
  - each request's logits must match its own batch-1 run.

  This also pins the static-batching plumbing above the mixer. The tolerance is `2e-2`. The two runs use different GEMM shapes, whose results agree to about `1e-3` relative on H100. A request decoded on another request's state is off by O(1).
- `tests/unit_tests/determinism/kernels/test_ssm_kernels.py::test_mixer_static_decode_replays` replays a 64-request static decode step bit-exactly. It is determinism coverage only. It is skipped only when `mamba_ssm` is missing: the mixer and its gated RMSNorm need it. The `ssm_mamba_mixer` manifest note mentions this test.

**GPU results.** On H100 in the CI image (first commit):
- The new tests fail on `main` in 1 of 4 cases: `test_static_decode_is_per_request[2]`, with request 1's output off by up to 1.31.
- They pass with this PR (4/4).
- The neighbor tests pass: `TestMambaMixer`, `TestHybridModel::test_inference` and `test_manifest.py`.

On H100 in the CI image (rerun at this PR's head), the regression tests pass (6/6) and 3 fail on `main`. The neighbor tests pass. On CPU, using `TRITON_INTERPRET=1` with a mixer built without TE:
- the shape-check test passes with this PR;
- it fails with the check removed;
- with the check but without the transposes, `test_static_decode_is_per_request[2]` now raises the shape assertion.

## Issue tracking

Linked issue: none; this PR's regression tests reproduce the bug.

## Code provenance

No external code was copied or adapted.

## Contribution process

### Pre-checks

- [x] I have added relevant unit tests
- [ ] I have added relevant functional tests
- [x] If this PR adds or changes a GPU kernel (Triton, `jit_fuser`/`torch.compile`, CUDA extension, TE or external-library dispatch, or a scatter/index accumulation), I have added or updated its bit-exact determinism test and registered it in `tests/unit_tests/determinism/kernels/manifest.py` ([guide](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/main/docs/developer/determinism/testing.md))
- [ ] I have added proper typing to my code [Typing guidelines](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html)
- [ ] I have added relevant documentation
- [x] I have run the [autoformatter.sh](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/main/tools/autoformat.sh) on my PR

+# --- Mamba mixer: static-batching decode (_static_decode) -----------------------------------

+def test_mixer_static_decode_replays():
+    """A static-batching decode step (one token for each of 64 requests) replays bitwise.
+
+    Determinism only: tests/unit_tests/ssm/test_mamba_mixer.py checks that each request decodes
+    on its own state slot.

+    mixer = _build_mixer(deterministic_mode=False)
+    try:
+        seeded()
+        batch = 64
+        conv_shape, ssm_shape = mixer.mamba_state_shapes_per_request()
+        hidden_states = torch.randn(
+            1, batch, mixer.config.hidden_size, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16
+        )
+        conv_state = torch.randn(batch, *conv_shape, device="cuda", dtype=mixer.conv1d_weight.dtype)
+        ssm_state = torch.randn(batch, *ssm_shape, device="cuda", dtype=mixer.in_proj.weight.dtype)
+
+        def fn(hidden_states, conv_state, ssm_state):
+            with torch.no_grad():
+                out, _ = mixer._static_decode(hidden_states, conv_state, ssm_state)
+            return out, conv_state, ssm_state
+
+        assert_replays_bit_exact(
+            fn,
+            (hidden_states, conv_state, ssm_state),
+            replays=4,
+            backward=False,
+            contention=True,
+            what="Mamba mixer static-batching decode",
+        )
+    finally:
+        Utils.destroy_model_parallel()

@@ -633,6 +633,55 @@ def test_inference(self):
                 assert logits.shape[1] == 1
             assert logits.shape[2] == self.model.vocab_size
 
+    def test_static_batch_inference_matches_single_requests(self):
+        """Each request in a static batch gets the logits it gets when run on its own."""
+        self.model.cuda()
+        self.model.eval()  # no dropout
+        max_sequence_length = self.model.max_sequence_length
+        prompt_length = 2
+        generator = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(0)
+        tokens = torch.randint(
+            self.model.vocab_size, (2, max_sequence_length), generator=generator, device="cuda"
+        )
+
+        def static_generation_logits(tokens):
+            """Prefill the prompt, then decode the remaining tokens one step at a time, as the
+            static-batching text generation controller does. Returns (batch, steps, vocab)."""
+            inference_context = StaticInferenceContext(
+                max_batch_size=tokens.shape[0], max_sequence_length=max_sequence_length
+            )
+            position_ids = torch.arange(max_sequence_length, device="cuda").expand_as(tokens)
+            windows = [(0, prompt_length)] + [
+                (start, start + 1) for start in range(prompt_length, max_sequence_length)
+            ]
+            logits = []
+            with InferenceMode.active():
+                for start, end in windows:
+                    if start > 0:
+                        inference_context.enable_decode_mode()
+                    logits.append(
+                        self.model.forward(
+                            input_ids=tokens[:, start:end],
+                            position_ids=position_ids[:, start:end],
+                            attention_mask=None,
+                            inference_context=inference_context,
+                            runtime_gather_output=True,
+                        )
+                    )
+                    inference_context.increment_sequence_len_offset(end - start)
+            return torch.cat(logits, dim=1)
+
+        batch_logits = static_generation_logits(tokens)
+        for i in range(tokens.shape[0]):
+            # The batched and single-request runs use different GEMM shapes, which agree to
+            # about 1e-3 relative; a request decoded on another request's state is off by O(1).
+            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                batch_logits[i : i + 1],
+                static_generation_logits(tokens[i : i + 1]),
+                atol=2e-2,
+                rtol=2e-2,
+            )
+
     def test_save_load(self, tmp_path):
         path = tmp_path / "model.pt"
         torch.save(self.model.state_dict(), path)

@@ -107,6 +107,84 @@ def test_variable_batch_size_inference(self):
                 assert output.shape[2] == mixer.config.hidden_size
                 assert output.dtype == torch.float32
 
+    @staticmethod
+    def _ssm_decode_one_request_at_a_time(mixer, zxBCdt, conv_state, ssm_state):
+        """Decode a batch-first (b, 1, proj) input with one single-request ssm_decode call per
+        request, updating that request's slot of the conv/SSM states in place."""
+        return torch.cat(
+            [
+                mixer.ssm_decode(
+                    zxBCdt[i : i + 1],
+                    conv_state=conv_state[i : i + 1],
+                    ssm_state=ssm_state[i : i + 1],
+                )
+                for i in range(zxBCdt.shape[0])
+            ]
+        )
+
+    def test_ssm_decode_is_batch_separable(self):
+        """ssm_decode on a batch-first input decodes each request on its own state slot."""
+        mixer = self.get_mixer()
+        batch_size = 2
+        zxBCdt = torch.randn(batch_size, 1, mixer.in_proj.weight.shape[0], device="cuda")
+        conv_shape, ssm_shape = mixer.mamba_state_shapes_per_request()
+        conv_state = torch.randn(batch_size, *conv_shape, device="cuda")
+        ssm_state = torch.randn(batch_size, *ssm_shape, device="cuda")
+        conv_ref, ssm_ref = conv_state.clone(), ssm_state.clone()
+
+        with torch.no_grad(), InferenceMode.active():
+            y = mixer.ssm_decode(zxBCdt, conv_state=conv_state, ssm_state=ssm_state)
+            y_ref = self._ssm_decode_one_request_at_a_time(mixer, zxBCdt, conv_ref, ssm_ref)
+
+        torch.testing.assert_close(y, y_ref, atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(conv_state, conv_ref, atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(ssm_state, ssm_ref, atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5)
+
+    def test_ssm_decode_rejects_sequence_first_input(self):
+        """Without batch_indices, a (1, b, proj) input would decode b requests on one slot."""
+        mixer = self.get_mixer()
+        batch_size = 2
+        zxBCdt = torch.randn(1, batch_size, mixer.in_proj.weight.shape[0], device="cuda")
+        conv_shape, ssm_shape = mixer.mamba_state_shapes_per_request()
+        conv_state = torch.zeros(batch_size, *conv_shape, device="cuda")
+        ssm_state = torch.zeros(batch_size, *ssm_shape, device="cuda")
+
+        with torch.no_grad(), InferenceMode.active():
+            with pytest.raises(AssertionError, match="one state slot per request"):
+                mixer.ssm_decode(zxBCdt, conv_state=conv_state, ssm_state=ssm_state)
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("batch_size", [1, 2])
+    def test_static_decode_is_per_request(self, batch_size):
+        """A static-batching decode step advances each request on its own state slot."""
+        mixer = self.get_mixer()
+        inference_context = StaticInferenceContext(
+            max_batch_size=batch_size, max_sequence_length=16
+        )
+        # Allocate the static state cache and give each request distinct states, as a prefill
+        # of `batch_size` requests would.
+        conv_state, ssm_state = mixer._get_states_from_cache(inference_context, batch_size)
+        conv_state.normal_()
+        ssm_state.normal_()
+        conv_ref, ssm_ref = conv_state.clone(), ssm_state.clone()
+
+        inference_context.sequence_len_offset = 8
+        inference_context.max_seqlen = inference_context.max_sequence_length
+        inference_context.seqlen_offset = inference_context.sequence_len_offset
+        hidden_states = torch.randn(1, batch_size, mixer.config.hidden_size, device="cuda")
+        with torch.no_grad(), InferenceMode.active():
+            output, _ = mixer(hidden_states, inference_context=inference_context)
+
+            # Reference: the same projections around one single-request decode per state slot.
+            zxBCdt, _ = mixer.in_proj(hidden_states)
+            y_ref = self._ssm_decode_one_request_at_a_time(
+                mixer, zxBCdt.transpose(0, 1), conv_ref, ssm_ref
+            )
+            output_ref, _ = mixer.out_proj(y_ref.transpose(0, 1))
+
+        torch.testing.assert_close(output, output_ref, atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(conv_state, conv_ref, atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(ssm_state, ssm_ref, atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5)
+
     @pytest.mark.parametrize("refresh_on_eval", [False, True], ids=["direct", "eval"])
     def test_refreshes_decode_cache_in_place(self, refresh_on_eval):
         mixer = self.get_mixer()
